entry_contract: Continue from 59 Winterspring & Blasted Lands, or select this chapter on a partially completed character. Begin in Burning Steppes with Oralius. Leave at least two quest-log slots open.

steps.instruction: Travel from Blasted Lands to Burning Steppes. Use a known flight path when it saves time; otherwise follow roads and zone connections. Continue to [G84.56,68.68 Burning Steppes]. [O]
Before you begin: travel to Burning Steppes and meet the first quest giver at [G84.56,68.68 Burning Steppes]. Leave at least two quest-log slots open. [O]
